name: Zenagamtide
sort_evidence: Zenagamtide is the INN for Novo's GLP-1/amylin co-agonist amycretin (https://chemxplore.com/news/zenagamtide-phase-2-diabetes-results), in Phase 3 AMAZE and AMBITION trials (NCT07797335 recruiting) with no approval; the NNC0487-0111 row in this batch points here.
